topic: How does the 14.6% bandwidth affect frequency planning for multi-satellite networks with adjacent channel interference risks?
consensus_response: The 14.6% bandwidth introduces adjacent channel interference (ACI) risks, particularly in Ku-band frequencies, degrading signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and reducing system capacity. NLPA-induced IMD exacerbates ACI effects, highlighting the need for advanced error correction codes and robust channel allocation strategies to mitigate ACI-induced errors. The narrow frequency band also increases the likelihood of interference between adjacent satellites, underscoring the importance of efficient resource utilization.
reference_context: The reference context highlights the impact of bandwidth on satellite communication systems, including signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), adjacent channel interference (ACI), and system capacity. It emphasizes the need for advanced error correction codes and robust channel allocation strategies to mitigate ACI-induced errors.
